meta_description:
178K likes, 1,044 comments - ishitamangal on February 7, 2026: "I was watching old Bollywood films and couldn’t stop noticing the hair. Women like Kajol and Madhuri Dixit had volume, texture, flyaways. Their hair moved when they moved. It looked like it had life in it. It looked real. 

Back then, that was just normal hair.
Today, the same hair would be called messy or “not done.” I know trends change. But I really miss when hair didn’t need control, heat, and perfection to be considered pretty. Sure even I enjoy my hair be styled and groomed but I would not like to be judged for the times that it’s not. 

Do you miss seeing real hair on screen and in reality too? 👀💭

Use hashtag #IMMyHair and tag me with your natural hair 💁🏻‍♀️

My jewelry is from @shilpigoyaljewellery 

(hair rant, talking about hair, hair thoughts, beauty talk, real vs processed hair) 
#HairTalk #RealHair HairTexture #UnprocessedHair Processedhair".
